info.value: vyAptAvaSnuta ityAhuraSnAtIti tu Bojane ' iti devaH . (166)

examples: 'pra te aSnotu kukzyoH' (f0 3.51.12). prASnotu prASnutAM vyApnotu.
'na nUnaM brahmaRAmfRaM prASUnAmasti sunvatAm' (f0 8.5.16). somaM prASnavate ye te prASavaH.
'svADyAyaviDiScoccAraRopayogi prASuBAvaPalakatayEvADyayanaM viDatte' (BA0 dI0 1.2.4). prakarzeRASuH prASuH, satDarataraH pratUrtaH, tasya BAvaH.
'dorBiScAtapadIptESca prAsEH prASESca mUrCanEH' (mAtsya0 pu0 177.12).
'samaSnute me laGimAnamAtmA' (raGu॰13.37). samaSnute=prApnoti.
'…pfcCyamAnA saKIyate. saM DItamaSnutaM narA…' (f॰8.40.3).. ito'BimuKamAgacCatam ityAha.
'suvargasya lokasya samazwyE' (tE0 saM0 5.7.2.2). samazwyE prAptyE.
'samAnaMSa samatiBiH ko asya' (f0 4.23.2). samAnaMSa samAnaSe saMBeje saMjagme.
'imAM vyazwiM vyASnuta' (Sa0 brA0 10.2.4.8). vyazwiH=AptiH, samfdDiH, sAPalyam.
'prajApatirakAmayata sarvA vyazwIrvyaSnuvIya' (Sa0 brA0 13.4.1.1). sarvA vyazwIH=sarvAnarTAn.
'yadeva hUyamAnasya vyaSnute' (Sa0 brA0 2.2.4.17). vyaSnute=Sizyate=urvaritaM Bavati.
'pratApastasya BAnoSca yugapad vyAnaSe diSaH' (raGu0 4.15). vyAnaSe=vyApa.
'te taM vyASizata' (Bawwi0 15.43). vyAptavantaH=parigatavantaH, parivezwitavanta ityarTaH.
'sa etenEkaSataviDenAtmanemAM jitiM jayatImAM vyazwiM vyaSnute' (Sa0 brA0 10.1.9.8). vyazwiH PalaM sAPalyam.
'ko vo mahAnti mahatAmud aSnavat' (f0 5.59.4). udaSnavat vyaSnavat vyaSnuvIta prApnuyAt. aSnavat iti paYcame lakAre rUpam.
'viSvA it spfDo aByaSnavAva' (f0 1.179.3). aBiBavevetyarTaH.
'tadasya priyamaBi pATo aSyAm' (f0 1.154.5). aByaSyAm prApnuyAm).
'aByASo ha yadasmE sa kAmaH samfDyet yatkAmaH stuvIta' (CAM0 u0 1.3.12). aByASa ASA.
'aByASo ha yadasmE sa kAmaH samfDyeta' (CAM0 u0 1.3.12). aByASa ASaMsA.
'kAmAdupASnanti sahasraSaste mudAnvitAH' (rA0 6.124.13). upASnanti upaBuYjate. upaSabdo DAtvarTasya na bahUpakaroti.
'anavyavahitaM yo vA nedaM vAkyamupASnute' (BA0 SAM0 142.24). upASnute'NgI karoti.
